title: Pan-cancer analysis implicates novel insights of lactate metabolism into immunotherapy response prediction and survival prognostication.
summary: Eight immunotherapy cohorts include a 772-patient meta-cohort; 9,815 TCGA cases and 4,434 additional cases are used for survival evaluation, with pancreatic organoid co-culture experiments.
ai_technology: A lactate-metabolism signature is evaluated for immunotherapy response and survival prediction across cancers; targeted cell/organoid experiments test LDHA-related effects.
organization: Department of General Surgery; Research Institute of Pancreatic Diseases; State Key Laboratory of Oncogenes and Related Genes

evidence.tested: Eight immunotherapy cohorts include a 772-patient meta-cohort; 9,815 TCGA cases and 4,434 additional cases are used for survival evaluation, with pancreatic organoid co-culture experiments.
evidence.unknown: The signature is a retrospective biomarker; experimental results support a candidate mechanism rather than treatment efficacy.
